sources.title: PrismML hopes its tiny LLM will change how we all use AI
sources.snippet: PrismML says it achieves this by shrinking the "weights" that make up a model — weights are, essentially, the information a model learns and stores during training.

sources.title: PrismML Emerges From Stealth With 1-Bit LLM Family
sources.snippet: PrismML unveils a 1-bit LLM that compresses model weights to reduce memory, latency, and energy use. The Bonsai models aim to enable efficient AI across edge and cloud environments.
